title: Auto Detailing Estimate Template
subtitle: An estimate pre-filled for detailing jobs — exterior wash, interior detail, full package, ceramic coating and paint polish. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Estimate valid for 30 days. A 25% deposit books the appointment; balance due at pickup.
notes: This is an estimate, not a final invoice. Final price depends on vehicle condition — heavily soiled interiors or paint defects may add prep time.
features: Auto-calculating totals and 25% deposit in Excel
Pre-filled detailing line items: wash & wax, interior, full package, ceramic, upholstery, polish
Vehicle field (make / model / VIN) keeps quotes accurate per car
Valid-until date + deposit section standard for detailing quotes

faqs.q: What should I include on an auto detailing estimate?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the client and vehicle details (make, model, VIN), a dated line-item list of services, a validity date, deposit terms, and a note that it is not a final invoice. Add a note that heavily soiled vehicles may require extra prep time.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantities and rates, and the subtotal, 25% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your tax authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
